entry.title: Reaction–diffusion competition drives anomalous relaxation of vitrimers
entry.summary:
Nature Physics, Published online: 15 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03468-0 Vitrimers—polymers that form covalent networks—show glassy behaviour with viscosity decoupled from structural relaxation. This decoupling is now found to originate from a competition between chemical exchange reactions and diffusion processes.

Source: Nature Physics · Tags: #quantum-physics #optics-photonics #clean-tech #computer-vision

entry.title: Error analysis of a backward L2 method on graded meshes for linear and semilinear subdiffusion equations
entry.summary:
Time-fractional linear and semilinear parabolic equations with a Caputo time derivative of order $α\in(0,1)$ are considered. Their solutions exhibit an initial singularity of type $t^σ$ for any fixed $σ\in (0,1) \cup (1,2)$. A backward L2-type discrete fractional-derivative operator of order $3-α$ is considered on nonuniform temporal meshes.

Source: arXiv Analysis, PDEs & Probability (AP, PR, NA, OC) · Tags: #analysis-pde #probability-stats #clean-tech #computer-vision
